data.summary: Experience luxury and performance with the 2015 Mercedes-Benz SL 400 Base model. Equipped with a powerful 3L V-6 329hp twin turbo engine and a 7-speed automatic transmission with overdrive, this vehicle delivers an impressive driving experience. Safety features include 4-wheel anti-lock brakes (ABS), side seat mounted airbags, curtain 1st row overhead airbag, driver and passenger knee airbag, airbag occupancy sensor, and a BabySmart airbag childseat sensor. Additional features include integrated navigation system, automatic air conditioning, 18" aluminum wheels, cruise control, ABS, and driveline traction control. Embrace elegance and power with the Mercedes-Benz SL 400 Base model.
